dedupe_keys.name: v2x measurement on m0 motorway with 4 vehicles

description: Budapest University of Technology and Economics and Microsec publish V2X communication logs from the M0 motorway. Zenodo provides the archive free under CC BY 4.0. Four Cohda MK5-equipped vehicles were tested on 19 May 2023, with two using public-key infrastructure and two without it. Received and transmitted JSON messages include CAM and DENM traffic, roadside messages and physical-layer measures such as received power and noise. These records can calibrate communication-delay and reception components in connected-vehicle simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this road trial. Coverage is one sunny, dry motorway session, not all traffic or radio conditions. Packet matching, clock alignment and the separation of security overhead from radio effects require checking. No archive was downloaded or communication-performance claim reproduced.
